newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan September gold imports down 14.23 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan September gold imports down 14.23 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's imports of gold bars, coins and plate fell in September to 7.369 tonnes from 8.592 tonnes in September 1995, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
Gold traders attributed the fall in imports to a slower market after a period of tension with China in March.
"After the high demand during the tension, demand fell and remained low," a gold trader said.
Taiwan imported a record 25.238 tonnes in March, a time of high political and military tension between Taiwan and rival China, a huge 162.4 percent rise compared with March 1995.
The gold stock accumulated since March would be slowly consumed by the end of 1996, gold traders said. Imports would return to normal in 1997, they added.
